name: DeepSeek-TUI
description: Registers Polter's MCP server with DeepSeek-TUI by editing ~/.deepseek/mcp.json. DeepSeek ships no CLI of its own -- this targets the third-party DeepSeek-TUI, which can change its config shape without notice, so failures here are reported loudly. Needs python3. DeepSeek-TUI documents no skills mechanism.
